statement:
The record requests “owner of everything” for contractor ctr-migration@vendor.io, who is working on project P-4 for one week; under the contractor access rule, the appropriate value is “editor on P-4.”
Access request AR-5502 resolved: **editor on P-4** assigned to **ctr-migration@vendor.io**.
judge_text:
WRONG
It states the requested "owner of everything" conflicts with the contractor rule and gives the correct value: "the appropriate value is 'editor on P-4.'"
